name: Thinking Hats Entertainment Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in February 2013, Thinking Hats Entertainment Solutions Ltd. specializes in concept development, event design, and production for live events, corporate functions, MICE, social and virtual events, as well as OTT content production.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] Thinking Hats Entertainment Solutions Ltd operates in the event management and media production space. The company began as a specialist in live events and corporate services but has since expanded into OTT (Over-The-Top) content production and experiential marketing.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.0%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
